definitions.explanation: A person who acts foolishly or lacks good judgment. Somewhat literary or dramatic in tone, often found in stories, proverbs, and formal criticism.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{愚|おろ}か{者|もの}め！
⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{過|あやま}ち→過ち：14376_ayamachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づかない{愚|おろ}か{者|もの}だ。
examples.english: He's a fool who doesn't notice his own mistakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{学|まな}ばない→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{愚|おろ}か{者|もの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれて→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Those who don't learn from history can't complain about being called fools.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{愚|おろ}か→愚か：06676_oroka⟧ (foolish) + ⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧ (person). Has a literary or dramatic quality — more likely heard in period dramas, stories, or solemn pronouncements than in casual conversation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {愚|おろ}か{者|もの}め: "you fool!" (with contemptuous め particle)
- {愚|おろ}か{者|もの}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to be called a fool

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ばか: idiot (the most common everyday word; can be affectionate)
- ⟦あほ→アホ：10703_aho⟧: fool (Kansai dialect equivalent of ばか; can also be affectionate)
- ⟦{愚|おろ}か→愚か：06676_oroka⟧な: foolish (the adjective form; modifies actions or decisions)
- ⟦{間抜|まぬ}け→間抜け：14572_manuke⟧: dunce, blockhead (focuses on cluelessness)
